use_cases: Map deployment tier strings to PCSTier enum values
Check if a PCS thrift server is running in production
Convert short tier names (ephemeral, rc, canary, latest) to enum
Convert fully qualified thrift service names to PCSTier enum
Handle unknown tier strings gracefully by returning UNKNOWN

apis.use_PCSTier_enum: use the PCSTier enum to represent PCS deployment tiers like EPHEMERAL, RC, CANARY, and PROD
apis.call_PCSTier_from_str: call PCSTier.from_str to map a tier string like ephemeral or rc to a PCSTier enum value
apis.check_PCSTier_PROD: check if a PCS server tier is PROD by comparing PCSTier.from_str result to PCSTier.PROD
apis.iterate_PCSTier_members: iterate over PCSTier members to list all available deployment tiers
apis.handle_PCSTier_UNKNOWN: handle unknown tier strings by checking if PCSTier.from_str returns PCSTier.UNKNOWN
